_about: The Retro band's animation library (the 'recipe'). scripts/pixellab/animate.py generates any that are missing in PixelLab; fetch_and_pack.py packs them. Every animation starts AND ends on the musician's standing pose (the 'hub'), so any animation can follow any other with no jump. block: which group the game picks from. energy: calm = verses, hype = choruses (any = both). beats: how many beats one loop lasts (loops), or how long a one-shot plays. canvas: the characters' size in PixelLab (64 px). version: bumped when an animation is redone; the new one is made as <member>_<name>_v2.

bassist.holding: holding his dark green electric bass guitar

anims.name: idle
anims.prompt: standing relaxed, breathing gently, small head nod

anims.name: calm
anims.prompt: playing the bass to a steady beat: right hand plucks the strings, gentle head nod, small knee bounce

anims.name: hype
anims.prompt: playing the bass energetically, head banging and bouncing hard on each beat

anims.name: step
anims.prompt: plucking the bass while stepping side to side and bobbing his head

anims.name: slap
anims.prompt: slapping the bass strings hard with his thumb while leaning back

anims.name: accent
anims.prompt: lifts the bass neck high in the air, leans back and does a little hop, then returns

anims.name: mistake_a
anims.prompt: flinches at a wrong note, his glasses slip down his nose and he pushes them back up

anims.name: mistake_b
anims.prompt: fumbles, hunches over the bass and grimaces, then shakes it off

anims.name: celebrate
anims.prompt: jumps and cheers, holding the bass up high in triumph, then lands

anims.name: bow
anims.prompt: takes a deep bow to the crowd, then stands back up

anims.name: idle

anims.name: calm

anims.name: hype

anims.name: point

anims.name: mistake_b

anims.name: celebrate

anims.name: bow
anims.prompt: takes a deep bow to the crowd, then stands back up

guitarist.holding: holding his dark red electric guitar

anims.name: idle
anims.prompt: standing relaxed, breathing gently, small head nod

anims.name: calm
anims.prompt: strumming the guitar steadily down and up, nodding his head

anims.name: hype
anims.prompt: playing the guitar with huge energy: big strumming arm swings, jumping up and down on the beat, head banging hard, guitar neck pumping up and down

anims.name: riff
anims.prompt: playing a fast riff while stepping forward with one foot and back

anims.name: windmill
anims.prompt: strumming the guitar with a big windmill swing of his right arm

anims.name: sing
anims.prompt: leans his face forward a little to sing into a microphone just in front of his mouth while strumming the guitar

anims.name: accent
anims.prompt: raises the guitar neck high and jumps, then lands

anims.name: mistake_a
anims.prompt: stops strumming, grimaces at the guitar, then shakes it off

anims.name: mistake_b
anims.prompt: flinches and shakes his strumming hand like it stings, then resumes

anims.name: celebrate
anims.prompt: jumps and cheers, holding the guitar up high in triumph, then lands

anims.name: bow
anims.prompt: takes a deep bow to the crowd, then stands back up

anims.name: idle
anims.prompt: standing relaxed, breathing gently, tapping one stick against his leg

anims.name: calm
anims.prompt: drumming with big visible arm swings: each arm alternately lifts its stick up to head height and strikes down hard, shoulders rocking, head nodding firmly to the beat (his drum kit hides everything below his chest, so all the motion is in his raised arms, head and hair)

anims.name: hype
anims.prompt: drumming wildly: both arms swing the sticks high above his head and smash down, violent head banging with his long hair flying, shoulders bouncing (his drum kit hides everything below his chest, so all the motion is in his raised arms, head and hair)

anims.name: fill
anims.prompt: a huge drum fill: both arms swing the sticks in wide high arcs from his far left across to his far right, whole upper body leaning with the swing, hair flicking (all the motion above his chest)

anims.name: twirl
anims.prompt: showing off: tosses the right stick spinning high above his head and catches it while the left arm keeps striking at shoulder height, then both arms strike down, grinning (all the motion above his chest)

anims.name: accent
anims.prompt: raises both sticks high above his head, then smashes them down together

anims.name: mistake_a
anims.prompt: drops one stick, fumbles and catches it, then resumes

anims.name: mistake_b
anims.prompt: loses the beat, freezes and looks embarrassed, then resumes

anims.name: celebrate
anims.prompt: throws both arms up with the sticks and cheers, then lowers them

anims.name: bow
anims.prompt: takes a deep bow to the crowd, then stands back up
